## Goal

Finalize decision and continuation for E150/E151 view-count principle experiments

## Summary

Completed E150 (Stack Overflow) and E151 (Software Engineering SE) experiments testing the view-count principle on two fresh Q&A forum domains. Both experiments showed negligible effect sizes (Cliff's delta = 0.014 and -0.094 respectively), with G2 (separation) failing in both cases. The view-count principle is not validated on Q&A forum venues, reinforcing the boundary condition that the principle's effect is specific to package repositories and code repositories with per-request metadata where need-related content has systematic activity advantages. D111 stands. STATE.md updated to reflect 18 experiments in 14 domains. Two fresh observations completed per stated rule. Experiment results preserved in EXPERIMENTS/E150-so-viewcount/ and EXPERIMENTS/E151-se-viewcount/.
